import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
breed_counts = pd.concat([
    df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts(),
    df['Rasse2Text'].value_counts()
]).groupby(level=0).sum().nlargest(10)

axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='steelblue')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()

# 2. Dogs by District (Kreis)
kreis_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].bar(range(len(kreis_counts)), kreis_counts.values, color='coral')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(len(kreis_counts)))
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(kreis_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Dogs by District')

# 3. Owner Age Distribution
age_counts = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='mediumseagreen')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Dogs by Owner Age Group')

# 4. Dog Age Distribution
dog_age_counts = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(15)
axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(dog_age_counts)), dog_age_counts.values, color='mediumpurple')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(dog_age_counts)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(dog_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Dogs by Age (Top 15)')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
